facts.text: Gibson is a virtual environment simulator for embodied agents, not a hardware device
Gibson simulates the agent with the Bullet physics engine
AntNavigateEnv is a CameraRobotEnv subclass whose constructor takes a configuration path and a GPU index
The documented interface is env.step(action) returning (obs, rew, env_done, info) and env.reset(); obs is a dictionary keyed by the configured output components
The play_ant_nonviz configuration sets is_discrete: true and output: [nonviz_sensor]
The play_ant_nonviz configuration sets the simulation timestep to 0.01 s with frameskip 1
With is_discrete true the Ant action space is gym.spaces.Discrete(17)
The 17 discrete Ant actions are 8 positive joint torques, 8 negative joint torques and one all-zero action
The Ant proprioceptive sensor has 28 values
calc_state concatenates eight body features, the joint state and the feet contacts and clips every element to [-5, 5]
AntNavigateEnv terminates the episode when nframe > 300
BaseRobotEnv._step increments nframe before applying the action and checking termination
The AntNavigateEnv reward is the change in the robot potential between steps
The potential is -walk_target_dist / scene.dt
walk_target_dist is the planar distance from the body to the target
A reset restores the configured initial position and orientation and then calls robot_specific_reset
On reset the ant joint angles are drawn uniformly from (-0.1, 0.1) through np_random
BaseEnv seeds np_random through gym.utils.seeding.np_random
The environment uses an in-process PyBullet connection: p.connect(p.DIRECT) headless or p.GUI with a display
The gym ids registered in gibson/__init__.py point at realenv.envs.* entry points
The scene advances one physics step with frame_skip per environment step

determinism.notes: A reset accepts a seed and the clone draws the reset joint angles from np_random (robot_locomotors.py:64-66, seeded by env_bases.py:90-92), so one seed and one action sequence repeat a trajectory. The package's fake uses Python's random.Random instead of numpy's generator, so a seed repeats the fake's trajectory but not an upstream one.

gaps: PyBullet rigid-body dynamics and contacts are replaced in the fake by a toy integrator: joint torques, contact forces, friction and the ant's 28-value proprioceptive state are not reproduced; only the array shape, the [-5, 5] clip and the 300-frame termination are kept
the camera modalities (rgb_filled, depth, normal, semantics), the CUDA point-cloud renderer and the downloaded scene database are not modelled; the package serves the nonviz_sensor configuration
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and lockstep ticks advance simulated time by 10 ms, and the GUI display path of the upstream is not run
the fake has no actuator, sensor or noise model and was never compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend needs the pinned gym 0.9.4 / pybullet 1.9.4 stack and a GPU, and was not run
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation is frozen: after a software e-stop the bridge accepts no step or reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
